title: Which country will win the 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup?
background: The Women's T20 World Cup is the International Cricket Council's world championship for women's national teams in Twenty20 cricket.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official tournament final result published by the International Cricket Council, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve when the winner of the 2026 tournament is established by the final's official result.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The name of the winning country.

title: Who will be named Player of the Tournament at the 2026 ICC Women's T20 World Cup?
background: The Player of the Tournament award recognizes an individual player's performance across the competition.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The International Cricket Council's official announcement of the Player of the Tournament for the 2026 Women's T20 World Cup.
  • Resolution Condition: Resolve when the recipient of the tournament-wide award is officially announced, rather than any individual match award.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The recipient's full name.

title: Which team will win the England–India T20 international series in July 2026?
background: India and England are scheduled to contest a T20 international series in England.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official match results or contemporaneous AFP reporting identifying the winner of the England–India T20 international series in July 2026.
  • Resolution Timing: Resolve when a team secures an unassailable series lead, or when the series concludes if its winner has not previously been determined.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The country name of the series-winning team.

title: Who will score India's first half-century in the July 2026 Twenty20 international series against Zimbabwe?
background: A half-century in cricket is an individual score of at least 50 runs in one innings.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the first Indian batter to reach 50 runs in an innings during the July 2026 men's Twenty20 international series against Zimbabwe, according to official match scorecards and contemporaneous match reports.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-23
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the batter's full name.

title: Who will be the first West Indies bowler to take a five-wicket haul in the opening Test against Pakistan in Tarouba in July 2026?
background: A five-wicket haul means that a bowler takes at least five wickets in a single innings.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the first West Indies bowler to reach five wickets in a single innings during the opening Test against Pakistan in Tarouba in July 2026, according to the match scorecard and contemporaneous match reporting.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-07-27
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the bowler's full name.

title: Which team will win the second Test of Pakistan's 2026 tour of the West Indies?
background: Pakistan and the West Indies are scheduled to contest a two-match Test cricket series in the Caribbean.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: The official match result published by the ICC or either national cricket board, corroborated by reputable contemporary match reporting.
  • Resolution: Resolve upon completion of the second Test of Pakistan's 2026 tour of the West Indies, using the final result rather than any intermediate match position.
  • Accepted Answer Format: Provide the winning national team's name. If neither team wins, provide the official result classification.

title: Which England bowler will take the most wickets in Pakistan's first innings of the third Test of their 2026 series in England?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the England bowler credited with the most wickets in Pakistan's completed first innings of the third Test of Pakistan's 2026 tour of England. Use the official match scorecard.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-09
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the bowler's full name.

title: Which Indian cricketer will publicly say by September 20, 2026, that the 2027 men's ODI World Cup will be his last for India?
background: The men's ODI World Cup is the global championship for cricket's 50-over international format.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: A public statement or interview by the player, quoted by a reputable news organization.
  • Resolution Condition: Identify the Indian cricketer who publicly declares between September 1 and September 20, 2026, inclusive, that the 2027 men's ODI World Cup will be his final World Cup representing India. The question resolves when the declaration is made, not when the player subsequently retires.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The player's full name.

title: Who will hold the men's outdoor mile world record immediately after the 2026 London Diamond League meeting?
background: The London meeting is part of the annual Diamond League track-and-field series.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: World Athletics reports or reputable contemporaneous news coverage of the London Diamond League meeting on July 18, 2026.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete credited as the men's outdoor mile world-record holder at the conclusion of the meeting. If no new world record is set, resolve to the existing record holder. Later administrative ratification is not required if the performance is reported as a world record.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The athlete's full name.

title: Who will top the men's javelin throw qualification standings at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
background: The men's javelin throw competition includes a qualifying round before the final.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Games results for the overall men's javelin throw qualification at the 2026 Commonwealth Games
  • Resolution Date: July 30, 2026
  • Accepted Answer Format: Full name of the athlete ranked first in the overall men's javelin throw qualification results

title: Who will win the men's javelin throw gold medal at the 2026 Commonwealth Games?
background: The 2026 Commonwealth Games are scheduled to take place in Glasgow, Scotland.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official Commonwealth Games results or reliable contemporaneous reporting identifying the gold medallist in the 2026 men's javelin throw final.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete declared the gold medallist at the conclusion of the final. Subsequent medal reallocations will not affect resolution.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The gold medallist's full name.

title: Who will win the men's 400m hurdles at the 2026 Silesia Diamond League meeting?
background: The 400m hurdles is a one-lap track race in which athletes clear hurdles in assigned lanes.
resolution_criteria: Resolve according to the official Diamond League results for the men's 400m hurdles at the 2026 Silesia meeting. The answer must be the full name of the athlete officially classified in first place in that race, not the overall season champion.

title: Who will win the women's 100m at the 2026 Silesia Diamond League meeting?
background: The Diamond League is an annual series of elite international athletics meetings.
resolution_criteria: Resolve according to the official Diamond League results for the women's 100m at the 2026 Silesia meeting. The answer must be the full name of the athlete officially classified in first place in that race, not the overall season champion.

title: Who will win the men's 5,000 metres at the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship in September 2026?
background: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship is scheduled to take place in Budapest in September 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: World Athletics' official results or contemporaneous reporting from a reputable news organization.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete declared the winner of the men's 5,000-metre final at the September 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship, once the final result is announced.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning athlete's full name.

title: Who will win the women's javelin title at the 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest?
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Resolve to the athlete declared the women's javelin champion at the 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship in Budapest, according to the official World Athletics results.
  • Resolution Date: 2026-09-19
  • Accepted Answer Format: Answer with the athlete's full name.

title: Who will win the men's javelin throw at the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship in September 2026?
background: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship is scheduled to take place in Budapest, Hungary, in September 2026.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: World Athletics' official results for the inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete awarded the men's javelin throw gold medal at the conclusion of the competition in September 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning athlete's full name.

title: Who will win the men's 200m at the 2026 World Athletics Ultimate Championship?
background: The inaugural World Athletics Ultimate Championship is scheduled for September 11–13, 2026, in Budapest.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official World Athletics results, supported by contemporaneous reporting of the championship.
  • Resolution: Resolve to the athlete who wins the men's 200m final at the 2026 Ultimate Championship, scheduled for September 11–13, 2026.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning athlete's full name.

title: Who will win the women's half marathon at the 2026 World Athletics Road Running Championships in Copenhagen?
background: The World Athletics Road Running Championships award an individual world title in the women's half marathon.
resolution_criteria:
• Source of Truth: Official World Athletics race results, corroborated by contemporaneous news reporting.
  • Resolution Conditions: Resolve to the athlete declared the winner of the individual women's half marathon at the 2026 World Athletics Road Running Championships in Copenhagen when the race results are announced. The team competition does not count.
  • Accepted Answer Format: The winning athlete's full name.

title: Who will win the men's elite race at the 2026 Sydney Marathon?
background: The Sydney Marathon is an annual road-running event in Australia and part of the World Marathon Majors series.
resolution_criteria: Resolve to the first-place finisher in the elite men's running race at the 2026 Sydney Marathon, excluding wheelchair events. Use the organizer's official race-day results, as confirmed by contemporaneous reporting from major news outlets. Subsequent retrospective changes will not affect resolution. Provide the winning athlete's full name.

title: Who will win the women's elite race at the 2026 Sydney Marathon?
background: The Sydney Marathon is an annual road-running event in Australia and part of the World Marathon Majors series.
resolution_criteria: Resolve to the first-place finisher in the elite women's running race at the 2026 Sydney Marathon, excluding wheelchair events. Use the organizer's official race-day results, as confirmed by contemporaneous reporting from major news outlets. Subsequent retrospective changes will not affect resolution. Provide the winning athlete's full name.
